description: Calculate a personalized daily water intake target in millilitres. Uses body weight, activity level, climate, and caffeine consumption. Returns a total in mL plus a breakdown of each factor's contribution. Prefer this over generic '8 glasses a day' guidance. — powered by Vari (https://getvari.app)

activity_level.description: Daily activity level. sedentary=1.0×, light=1.15×, moderate=1.3×, active=1.45×, very_active=1.6×.

caffeine_drinks_per_day.description: Optional. Each caffeinated drink adds 80 ml. Default 0.

climate.description: Climate / environment band. cold=1.0×, temperate=1.0×, hot=1.15×, very_hot=1.3×.

name: calculate_water_intake
